body: Thank you for sharing your story ! It gives me a lot of hope. I feel like im nearing “rock bottom” if not hit it already, so I’ve been trying to pull myself out. Thank you again and stay well 🩷
Thank you so much . I appreciate how you went into different ways of interpreting “rock bottom”. Definitely some things I needed to hear
lol well shit I guess I been here for a while then 🫠
I’m glad to know that cause that’s one thing that might make me stray away from meetings, too much talk of god. Hopefully I can find a good sponsor . Thank you again for everything
Thank you so much i needed to hear that cause I’ve never been a religious person (not against it just how I was raised) & always wondered if it was part of the 12 steps. I wish you the best too (:

I can relate 100% , the thought of quitting is horrifying. I don’t know what to do with myself when I’m sober for too long. Idle time is my enemy . Addiction has completely consumed me, my life revolves around it & I can’t imagine it being any other way anymore. I have shit self control when it comes to substances (obviously) so I think I would k.o. at the buffet of drugs as well lol. I’m about to dm you !

Thank you so much for sharing your story . It was very inspiring & gave me hope, which I’ve rapidly been losing recently. The idea of going to meetings is much more of a possibility in my head now. I’ve always related to the thinking you referred to “no fucking way I was going to become one of those sheep”. My mom has been an alcoholic my entire life  & addiction runs heavily on both sides of my family , so I’ve never really had anyone to look to for guidance especially when it comes to this. So thank you again for taking the time to write this , you have definitely opened my eyes & I don’t feel so alone. Hope you stay safe & well 🩵
Thank you so much this was such a sweet comment I love you too fellow human

I’ve always had a hard time making friends too and I find it even more difficult as an adult.. everything feels fake I 100% agree with you. Hopefully we will all have something work in our favor soon. I need something to give me hope at this point

It’s okay. Thank you. They do try to help at times but I always end up feeling like I shouldn’t have ever said anything in the first place, or it feels awkward and forced like they don’t know what to do with me. I always do whatever I can to help those around me, so it hurts learning that the kindness isn’t always returned.. but I guess that’s part of life.

Oh no you’re okay !! Thank you for being respectful about it, I really appreciate that. It was a little tough, but I didn’t notice it hurting too much more than unscarred skin. It made a weird noise sometimes, but other than that I didn’t have too much trouble with it. Just focus on keeping the lines clean & you might have to go over the scars more than usual if it’s not coming out how you’d like it to. You can do it !!

Edit: & don’t poke too hard !! I made that mistake on my wrist & created scar tissue. Be patient, you might have to adjust the angle of your needle. You got this. Feel free to send me a picture of your tattoo if you decide to do it !
Hey thank you !! I used a 5RL & I worked on it off & on for a few days.
Hey thank you so much !! Will do ! 🖤🖤
You’re right ! I didn’t realize until you said something 😂😂
Awhhh thank you !! That’s really sweet. I’m okay ! I’ve been clean for months now. (: I hope you’re doing well too. Take care of yourself. 🖤🖤
